name: Level 32: Multi-Core Mutex Spinlock
description: Multi-Core Mutex Synchronization! RAM 0 is atomic lock (0=UNLOCKED). Robot 0 reads 10 from Inbox (0,1), acquires lock, adds 5 (15), stores in RAM 1, releases lock, and signals Robot 1. Robot 1 acquires lock, reads RAM 1 (15), adds 5 (20), and drops into Outbox (6,1)!
